$comment: Discipline-specific validator registry (app_design.md §7.4). The tool's core validation (Croissant structural+referential, SHACL for PROV-O, identifier grounding) is general; this registry catalogues field-specific validators surfaced by declared format / Pathway-C sub-domain. 'execution' controls integration: 'in-browser' validators can run in place and mark a criterion automated; 'cli'/'web-service' validators are referenced and their outcome recorded as attested evidence. 'applies_to' is open-world (free tags: format names and/or sub-domain ids), not validated against vocabularies.json. For disciplines outside this seeded set, the 'registries' below are the authoritative lookup.

validators.note: The BIDS Validator runs in your browser at its own site: point it at the dataset directory and record the report as attested evidence. A JS/Deno build exists and could one day run inside this tool, which does not embed it today.
Run frictionless validate over the data package and record the report as attested evidence. General-purpose, so it applies across disciplines. A JavaScript port exists. This tool does not embed it.
The tool's own engine for graph-level validation; used for the PROV-O record and any RDF release. Listed here to document the general RDF option.
Expresses distribution, missingness, range, and uniqueness checks as a suite that runs in CI. Produces the profiling report that backs the L2 characterization rows.
Schema and hypothesis checks against a dataframe, in the pipeline that produced it. Lighter to adopt than a full expectation suite.
The same class of statistical and structural checks for datasets too large to profile on one machine.

Representation and parity metrics across protected attributes. Produces the report that is the evidence for the L3 bias-audit row. Compare before and after curation, so introduced skew shows alongside released-state parity.
Group-fairness metrics and a dashboard. Overlaps Aequitas. Either satisfies the bias-audit evidence.
Python CLI. Run externally and record the report as attested evidence.
Desktop/CLI tooling. Run externally and record the outcome as attested evidence.
Hosted web service. Submit externally and record the validation summary as attested evidence.
IUCr hosted service. Upload the CIF and record the report as attested evidence. Also runs as part of IUCr journal submission.
Python CLI. Validates an OPTIMADE endpoint against the specification. Applies when the dataset is served from a queryable endpoint.

validators.discipline: Materials / neutron, X-ray, and muon experiments
validators.note: Validates an HDF5 file against a NeXus application definition. Run externally and record the outcome as attested evidence.

registries.note: Registry of standards, databases, and policies tagged by discipline; authoritative entry point for the long tail.

registries.note: Discipline-organised metadata standards with implementation tools and repository use cases.

registries.note: Community-maintained successor to the DCC catalogue; versioned, open codebase.
